topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe what I'm hearing. My friend, the one I thought I knew, the one who claimed to be climbing the corporate ladder, is actually just... What even is he doing all day? I keep picturing him, sitting there, pretending, while everyone around him believed. How could I not see it? Every story, every proud update, it was all just a construct. I'm not sure what to feel, but I find myself stepping back, looking at everything he's said through a new lens. Trust is a fragile thing, and now, I'm just not sure what's real anymore.
